question:
Which letter-cluster will replace the question mark (?) to complete the given series?

ZOFB, ?, VKJF, TILH, RGNJ
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/768ffa75a91f088695c16a6deb50b713a526fcdb17ebb80961c20654cb850baa.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

**First two letters are decreasing by -2 and last two letters are increasing by +2.**

On continuing the pattern, we get,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91e64345cd70c604b8a7fca043bcb2b165bc5e3517eb4fd936064939e96efcf5.png] 

Hence, ‘**XMHD**’ is the correct answer.
